text:
Sam: Quick sync — we need to pick the 2 things to ship from Optimize this sprint. Customers are asking for (A) eval-triggered alerts for regressions, (B) batching/caching guidance + live hints in Console, (C) quantization recommendations for cost-sensitive tiers. What should we prioritize?
Lee: my vote is B + A. B buys customers immediate cost wins and is lower infra risk. A is high impact for trust.
Anita: +1 B first. For A we need a clear signal spec (concordance, latency regressions). Otherwise we'll spam teams.
Maya: customer voice: AcmeHealth and Nimbus both want alerting tied to evaluation suites — they care more about false positives being low.
Carlos: infra note — quant recs are tricky because we need benchmark harness and canary rollout automation. Not safe for this sprint unless we scope tiny.
deploy-bot: new deploy: optimize-toolkit/console-hints v2 deployed to staging :rocket:
Sam: thanks — can we define MVP criteria for A and B so Eng can scope? Suggestion: B=MVP: Console shows per-route batching suggestion + one-click cache TTL profile and an estimated cost delta. A=MVP: Eval alerts for model drift based on either concordance drop or embedding cosine drift with throttle and quiet window.
Lee: estimate: B MVP ~ 6 dev-days (backend + UI) if we limit to top-3 routes; A MVP ~ 8 dev-days if we reuse eval infra and throttle.
Anita: signal thresholds proposal: concordance delta > 7% OR embedding mean cosine drop > 0.06 for > 3 runs triggers alert. Also require fails >=2 consecutive runs to avoid flapping. (example: `concordance_change = -0.07 && runs>=2`)
Maya: for customers, add checkbox in alert setup: "Only notify on confirmed regressions (requires review)" — prefer fewer noisy alerts.
Sam: decision proposal: Prioritize B (batching/caching hints) and ship slim A (alerting but behind feature flag with 24h quiet window and manual confirmation). Defer quant recs to next sprint as a research spike. Any objections?
Carlos: no objections. We should add a metric SLI: alerts false-positive rate < 10% in pilot.
Lee: ack. I'll size and create tickets: OPT-142 (batching hints top-3 routes), OPT-143 (cache TTL profiles + cost delta), OPT-144 (eval-alerts behind FF, pilot mode).
Anita: I'll draft the signal thresholds doc and a quick eval harness example. Putting a short snippet for tests:
```
# pseudo-config
alert: concordance_regression
threshold: 0.07
consecutive_runs: 2
quiet_window: 24h
notify: channel
```
Lee: timeline check — aiming for internal pilot by EOW next week if no blockers.
Maya: will coordinate with AcmeHealth for pilot opt-in.
Sam: Action items: Lee create tickets & PR plan, Anita signal doc + sample evals, Maya customer pilot list, Carlos define SLI/monitoring. We'll reconvene Wed for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
